name: Semantic Conflict Preservation Registry
purpose: Preserve irreducible semantic tensions as structural information rather than interpretive defects.

conflict_classes.definition: The structural tension between local interpretive stability and global continuation requirements.
Conflicts arising from mapping discrete aspect roles to continuous flow-based semantic analogs.
The tension between embedded interpretive limits and the assumption of detached symbolic assignment.
Irreducible gaps in semantic translation between distinct reconstruction domains.
Semantic tensions generated by the interaction of bounded self-reference and interpretive drift.

mandatory_rules.rule: Semantic conflict removal requires explicit multi-aspect justification and loss-accounting update.
Forced semantic unity triggers a mandatory governance review of the affected artifacts.
Semantic tension may be classified as structurally irreducible and thus a source of information.

governance_rules.rule: Reconstruction semantics must report conflicts as 'preserved' rather than 'resolved' unless C5+ evidence is provided.

forbidden_claims: Semantic alignment resolves the discrete/continuous meaning conflict.
Geometric meaning smoothing justifies the erasure of local interpretive thresholds.
Conflict preservation is an optional metadata field.
